periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Held six blood pressure and diabetes screening events at library branches and the Community Health Center, with same-day results. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Bring blood pressure checks to faith partner sites.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Held 11 screening events, including blood pressure checks at four congregations. Residents with high readings now leave with a clinic appointment. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, faith partners, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add diabetes screening at the Bayfront farmers market and expand faith partner events.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Ran 16 community screening events, including blood pressure checks at faith partner sites and diabetes screenings at the Bayfront farmers market. Several hundred residents received same-day results, and those with high readings were given a clinic appointment. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, faith partners, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Pair events with colorectal screening kit handouts and track follow-up visits.
